name: ARK: Survival Evolved
tagline: Exact-build native Linux connector for ARK dedicated servers; the plugin connects to Takaro itself.
requirements: ARK Linux dedicated server build 21241282 with the cataloged executable SHA-256
Control of the server launch command (LD_PRELOAD through the shipped launch.sh)

assets.label: Native server plugin
assets.hint: Unzip into <ark install>/TakaroArk, set TAKARO_REGISTRATION_TOKEN in TakaroArkNative/takaro.cfg and start the server through TakaroArkNative/launch.sh.
